unitTitle: An Early Bird or a Night Owl?
scanNote:
WORKBOOK 21-BET. Unit 5 — his-tuyg'ular, do/get/have/go, takrorlanish ravishlari.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 5-mashq (4 gap), 6-mashq (10 fe'l + 10 namuna), 7-mashq (3 odam haqida matn), 8-mashq (5 gap), 9-mashq (5 so'z tartibi) — jami 35 dan ortiq javob.

⚠ 6-MAShQ — TO'RT FE'L, TO'RT GURUH (ingliz tilida bular BARQAROR birikma, tarjima qilib bo'lmaydi):
  HAVE — a bath/shower, breakfast/lunch/dinner
  DO   — your homework, the washing-up
  GO   — home, shopping, on a picnic, out
  GET  — up, dressed
  ⚠ O'zbekchada hammasi 'qilmoq' yoki 'olmoq' bo'lishi mumkin, lekin inglizchada har biriga ANIQ fe'l biriktirilgan. 'Make homework' yoki 'take a shower' (britancha emas) — xato.
  ⚠ 'go home' — 'to' QO'YILMAYDI ('go to home' xato).

⚠ 8-MAShQ — FOIZ VA RAVISh JADVALI (kitobda chiziqda berilgan):
  0% never · 10% rarely · 25% sometimes · 50% often · 75% usually · 100% always
  ⚠ Rasmlar bo'yicha: dush 75% → usually; tennis 25% → sometimes; kruassan 100% → always; qahva 0% → never; teatr 50% → often; musiqa 10% → rarely.

⚠ 9-MAShQ — RAVISh QAYERDA TURADI:
  oddiy fe'ldan OLDIN: 'Sarah NEVER gets up', 'I OFTEN meet', 'Claire RARELY goes', 'We SOMETIMES go'
  ⚠ Lekin 'to be' dan KEYIN turadi ('He is ALWAYS late') — bu betda bunday band yo'q, lekin qoidani bilish kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Read what each person says. Then, choose adjectives from the list to make sentences about how each person feels, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir odam nima deyayotganini o'qing. So'ng ro'yxatdan sifat tanlab, ular qanday his qilishini gap bilan ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
SIFATLAR: tired, stressed, bored, satisfied, happy

NAMUNA:
  Jenny: 'I've got a great job.'
  → Jenny feels SATISFIED BECAUSE she has got a great job.

QOLIP:
  ISM + feels + SIFAT + BECAUSE + sabab.

IKKI O'ZGARISH kerak:
  1) 'I' → 'he' yoki 'she'
  2) fe'l 3-shaxs -s oladi:
     I've got → she HAS got
     I do     → he DOES
     I don't get → she DOESN'T get
     I have   → he HAS
     I like   → she LIKES

MANTIQ BILAN MOSLANG:
  ajoyib ish        → satisfied (mamnun)
  bir xil ish takror → bored (zerikkan)
  kam uxlash        → tired (charchagan)
  ko'p muammo       → stressed (asabiy)
  hayotini yoqtirish → happy (baxtli)

example.speaker: namuna
example.en: Jenny feels satisfied because she has got a great job.
example.uz: Jenni o'zini mamnun his qiladi, chunki uning ajoyib ishi bor.

modelSentences.word: TIM: 'I do the same things again and again.'
modelSentences.sentence: Tim feels bored because he does the same things again and again.
modelSentences.uz: Tim o'zini zerikkan his qiladi, chunki u qayta-qayta bir xil ish qiladi.

modelSentences.sentence: Sarah feels tired because she doesn't get much sleep.
modelSentences.uz: Sara o'zini charchagan his qiladi, chunki u kam uxlaydi.

modelSentences.word: JAMES: 'I have a lot of problems.'
modelSentences.sentence: James feels stressed because he has a lot of problems.
modelSentences.uz: Jeyms o'zini asabiy his qiladi, chunki uning ko'p muammosi bor.

modelSentences.word: KAREN: 'I like the way I live.'
modelSentences.sentence: Karen feels happy because she likes the way she lives.
modelSentences.uz: Karen o'zini baxtli his qiladi, chunki u yashash tarzini yoqtiradi.
modelSentences.note: IKKI fe'l o'zgaradi: 'I like' → 'she LIKES', 'I live' → 'she LIVES'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the table with DO, GET, HAVE, GO, then make sentences using them.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni DO, GET, HAVE, GO fe'llari bilan to'ldiring, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RTTA FE'L — TO'RTTA GURUH.

Bu fe'llar o'zbek tiliga BOSHQACHA tarjima qilinadi, shuning
uchun ularni BIRIKMA holida yodlash kerak:

  HAVE — ovqat va yuvinish:
    have a bath / a shower
    have breakfast / lunch / dinner
    (o'zbekchada 'qilmoq': nonushta QILMOQ)

  DO — bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan ish:
    do your homework
    do the washing-up
    (o'zbekchada 'bajarmoq', 'yuvmoq')

  GO — biror joyga yoki mashg'ulotga borish:
    go home, go shopping
    go on a picnic, go out (with friends/family)

  GET — holat o'zgarishi:
    get up, get dressed
    (o'zbekchada 'turmoq', 'kiyinmoq')

DIQQAT: 'do the washing-up' — 'wash' EMAS.
Va 'have a shower' — 'do a shower' EMAS.

items.whyUz: 'have a bath/shower'. AQShda 'take a shower' ham.
'have breakfast' — artikl YO'Q. Ovqat bilan doim 'have'.
'do the washing-up' — turg'un birikma. AQShda 'do the dishes'.

exercises.instructionUz: So'ng shu birikmalar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir birikma bilan to'liq gap tuzing.
Vaqt yoki takrorlanish ravishini qo'shsangiz — gap boyroq bo'ladi.

modelSentences.sentence: I have a shower at half past seven every morning.
modelSentences.uz: Har ertalab yetti yarimda dush qabul qilaman.

modelSentences.sentence: She has breakfast at eight o'clock.
He always does his homework after school.
modelSentences.uz: U doim maktabdan keyin uy vazifasini bajaradi.

modelSentences.sentence: I usually do the washing-up after dinner.
modelSentences.uz: Odatda kechki ovqatdan keyin idish yuvaman.

modelSentences.sentence: They go home at five o'clock.
My family often goes on a picnic in the summer.
She goes out with friends every Friday.
modelSentences.uz: U har juma do'stlari bilan sayrga chiqadi.

modelSentences.sentence: I get up at seven o'clock in the morning.
He gets dressed after his shower.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the chart below and make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi jadvalga qarang va namunadagidek gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL:
  NAME  | JOB       | PLACE            | START | FINISH
  Bob   | doctor    | hospital         | 06:30 | 20:30
  Brett | life-guard| swimming pool    | 09:00 | 19:15
  Jean  | reporter  | newspaper office | 10:45 | 18:30

NAMUNA (Bob):
  Bob is a doctor. He works at a hospital.
  He starts work at half past six in the morning.
  He finishes work at half past eight in the evening.

QOLIP — TO'RT GAP:
  1) ISM + is a + KASB.
  2) He/She works at a + JOY.
  3) He/She starts work at + VAQT + kun qismi.
  4) He/She finishes work at + VAQT + kun qismi.

DIQQAT — 24 SOATLIK VAQTNI 12 SOATLIKKA aylantiring:
  06:30 → half past six IN THE MORNING
  20:30 → half past eight IN THE EVENING (20 − 12 = 8)
  19:15 → a quarter past seven IN THE EVENING (19 − 12 = 7)
  18:30 → half past six IN THE EVENING (18 − 12 = 6)
  10:45 → a quarter to eleven IN THE MORNING

JEAN — AYOL ismi, shuning uchun 'She'.

structure.modelEn: Bob is a doctor. He works at a hospital.
He starts work at half past six in the morning.
He finishes work at half past eight in the evening.
structure.noteUz: 20:30 = 8:30 pm → half past eight in the evening.

structure.modelEn: Brett is a life-guard. He works at a swimming pool.
He starts work at nine o'clock in the morning.
He finishes work at a quarter past seven in the evening.
Jean is a reporter. She works at a newspaper office.
She starts work at a quarter to eleven in the morning.
She finishes work at half past six in the evening.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the drawings, the adverbs of frequency and the prompts below to talk about Faye and her activities.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlar, takrorlanish ravishlari va berilgan so'zlar yordamida Fey va uning mashg'ulotlari haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
FOIZ SHKALASI (kitobdagi chiziq):
  0%   never
  10%  rarely
  25%  sometimes
  50%  often
  75%  usually
  100% always

FEYNING MASHG'ULOTLARI:
  1  have / shower / evening      (75%)
  2  play / tennis / afternoon    (25%)
  3  eat / a croissant / morning  (100%)
  4  drink / coffee / night       (0%)
  5  go / theatre / weekend       (50%)
  6  listen / music / evening     (10%)

NAMUNA:
  Faye USUALLY HAS a shower IN THE evening.

QOLIP:
  Faye + RAVISH + fe'l+S + to'ldiruvchi + vaqt predlogi.

UCH NARSAGA DIQQAT:
  1) ravish fe'ldan OLDIN
  2) fe'l 3-shaxs -s oladi (Faye — ayol ismi)
  3) vaqt predlogi to'g'ri bo'lsin:
     in the evening / afternoon / morning
     AT night (istisno!)
     AT the weekend (istisno!)

example.speaker: namuna
example.en: Faye usually has a shower in the evening.
example.uz: Fey odatda kechqurun dush qabul qiladi.

modelSentences.sentence: Faye sometimes plays tennis in the afternoon.
Faye always eats a croissant in the morning.
modelSentences.uz: Fey har doim ertalab kruassan yeydi.

modelSentences.sentence: Faye never drinks coffee at night.
modelSentences.uz: Fey kechasi hech qachon qahva ichmaydi.
modelSentences.note: 0% → never. 'AT night' — istisno predlog. 'doesn't' KERAK EMAS.

modelSentences.sentence: Faye often goes to the theatre at the weekend.
modelSentences.uz: Fey dam olish kunlari tez-tez teatrga boradi.
modelSentences.note: 50% → often. 'go TO THE theatre'. 'AT the weekend' — istisno.

modelSentences.sentence: Faye rarely listens to music in the evening.

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the sentences in the correct order.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'Z TARTIBI:
  EGA + RAVISH + FE'L + TO'LDIRUVCHI + JOY/VAQT

NAMUNA:
  early / up / Sarah / gets / never
  → Sarah never gets up early.
     ↑     ↑      ↑     ↑
    ega  ravish  fe'l  qanday

RAVISH DOIM fe'ldan OLDIN ('to be' dan tashqari).

VAQT VA JOY gap OXIRIDA turadi:
  at two o'clock, after school, to the cinema

items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Ega + ravish + fe'l + qanday.

items.answer: Alan usually has lunch at two o'clock.
items.whyUz: 'usually' fe'l 'has' dan oldin. Vaqt gap oxirida: 'at two o'clock'.

items.answer: I often meet my friends after school.
items.whyUz: 'often' fe'l 'meet' dan oldin. 'my friends' — to'ldiruvchi. 'after school' — vaqt.
'rarely' fe'l 'goes' dan oldin. 'go ON picnics' — 'on' bilan.

items.answer: We sometimes go to the cinema.
items.whyUz: 'sometimes' fe'l 'go' dan oldin. 'go TO THE cinema' — 'to' va 'the' shart.

wordFormation.introUz: Workbook 21-bet — to'rtta asosiy fe'l va ularning birikmalari.

groups.explanationUz: O'zbekchada har xil fe'l bilan aytiladi, inglizchada esa hammasi 'have'.
Predlog har xil bo'ladi — buni yodlash kerak.
Jadvalda 24 soatlik, gapda esa 12 soatlik ishlatiladi. 12 dan katta sonlardan 12 ni ayiring.

items.derived: half past six in the morning
half past eight in the evening
a quarter past seven in the evening
half past six in the evening
a quarter to eleven in the morning

patterns.exampleEn: Jenny feels satisfied because she has got a great job.
patterns.exampleUz: Jenni o'zini mamnun his qiladi, chunki uning ajoyib ishi bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
'feel' dan keyin SIFAT keladi.
To'g'ridan-to'g'ri nutqni 3-shaxsga o'tkazganda fe'l -s oladi.

patterns.formula: ISM + is a + KASB. He/She works AT a + JOY.
patterns.exampleEn: Bob is a doctor. He works at a hospital.
patterns.explanationUz: Kasb oldida artikl SHART. Ish joyi bilan AT.

patterns.formula: He/She starts/finishes work AT + vaqt + IN THE + kun qismi.
patterns.exampleEn: He starts work at half past six in the morning.
patterns.exampleUz: U ertalab olti yarimda ishni boshlaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'start/finish work' — artikl YO'Q. Vaqt bilan AT, kun qismi bilan IN THE.

patterns.exampleEn: Faye usually has a shower in the evening. Faye never drinks coffee at night.
patterns.exampleUz: Fey odatda kechqurun dush qabul qiladi. Fey kechasi hech qachon qahva ichmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ravish fe'ldan OLDIN. 'never' bilan 'doesn't' KERAK EMAS.
'at night' va 'at the weekend' — istisno predloglar.

patterns.exampleEn: I often meet my friends after school. We sometimes go to the cinema.
patterns.exampleUz: Men tez-tez maktabdan keyin do'stlarim bilan uchrashaman. Biz ba'zan kinoga boramiz.
patterns.explanationUz: So'z tartibi: ega → ravish → fe'l → to'ldiruvchi → vaqt/joy.
